meta_description: Yeni Hali: Inside the dual-city practice of Silver & Elegant — London design and Istanbul master craftsmanship.

sections.label: The Founder
sections.title: Esen Tunalı Sarı
sections.body: SILVER & ELEGANT is shaped by the independent vision of its founder, uniting architectural discipline with the heritage of craftsmanship. Our practice is built on the commitment to constructing timeless, structural forms beyond the reach of fleeting trends.

sections.label: The Craftsman
sections.title: Atelier Kapalıçarşı
sections.body:
Every SILVER & ELEGANT piece is cast and hand-worked by our master artisan in Kapalıçarşı, Istanbul. Trained over decades in techniques passed down rather than taught in a classroom, our craftsman possesses a deep, intuitive material intelligence — understanding where the metal wants to flow, where the hammer must strike, and where the surface should be softened. This human element ensures that no two pieces are identical, preserving authentic human touch in an age of machine replication.

We choose not to share individual identities beyond the brand itself. The work speaks for the practice.

sections.label: The Workspace
sections.title: Borehamwood & Istanbul
sections.body: Our workspace exists in a state of continuous dialogue between two cities. In our studio in Borehamwood, London, the structural forms are shaped, the proportions are studied, and the design language is refined. In Istanbul, the fire is lit, the crucible is poured, and the metal is finished by hand. This dual model combines contemporary architectural vision with centuries-old metalworking traditions, creating a unique signature of wearable art.
